full_page.content:
1952, April 12
The following is a faithful transcription of photo copies of handwritten messages on Seraphic Mass Association Cards by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, C.F.M.Cap.
Mrs. George Panyard Sr.
with whole Family - for God's Guidance - for a holy Easter Holy Thursday April 10, 1952
God bless all and each. - A Blessed Eastertide Fr. Solanus, O.F.M.Cap. a Friend - and Fr. Solanus, O.F.M.Cap.
1954, July 28
Mrs. Harriett Panyard - for speedy health improvement, D.V. God bless you Mrs. Panyard
special enrollment of Mrs. Harriette Panyard by Daughter Doris
Fr. Solanus, O.F.M.Cap. July 28 - 1954
Originals in possession of: Doris Panyard 3248 Maple Grove Rd. Apt. 37 Muskegon, Mich. 49441
